Title: [Submission] Ahab, the Traitor (g5 Baali with VAL, !salubri hoser)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Ahab, the Traitor
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Baali
Capacity: 8
Group: 5
Discipline: for obf AUS DAI VAL
Independent. Infernal: Damage inflicted by your minions on Salubri antitribu is aggravated. During the press step of a combat that does not involve Ahab, he can tap to inflict strength damage to one of the combatants. +1 strength.

Source: clanbook Salubri p.66
whitewolf.wikia.com/wiki/Ahab

Ahab could be a new friend to Saulot (paradoxically) as well as other Baali (since g5 is quite poor). He embodies the Baali war between the Baali and the Salubri warriors.

Obviously, the anti-!Sal special is very flavoursome but extremely corner-case, so ignoring that.

Having two bloodlines disciplines is quiet pokey, although there isn't that much easy synergy between them. If you do actually team up with Saulot or some other Val users, you start losing the option to play some of the Baali-relevant cards to good effect (e.g. a Path of Evil Revelations that is used in some TWDAs to offset infernal costs), at which point his infernalism becomes more relevant. Though, if you choose to play Blessing of the Name with a !Sal, BotN's downside - "During your untap phase, burn this card and tap the chosen minions" - becomes potentially less annoying, since you can order his infernalism untap after that.

If you're using his other special on your own combats (i.e. someone you control is in the combat), it's quite expensive - he has to tap to inflict 2 damage, and tapping with an infernal vampire is quite expensive.

Nergal has some possible synergy with AUS/OBF/FOR/DAI though he's incentivized to be a bit more active and bleedy - and Ahab lacking any Presence would be a bit annoying for that, when Nergal might want to chew through a few Legal Manipulations, Enchant Kindred or Aire of Elation.

He might make a fun blocking vampire, with Diabolic Lure. You can potentially cycle it at fallback Auspex level with !Sal cohorts. Of course, actually blocking taps you, and actually untapping (to use his special) is harder. Making him an important vampire in an Aus/For/Val deck with some Daimoinon/Baali tricks might well be quite fun, though. Plus the Blessing of the Name, as above.

It seems a bit niche, but could be potentially quite a lot of fun in that niche.

Edit to add:
I wrote above:
If you're using his other special on your own combat

But forgot to add the other half I meant to:

If you're using him on other people's combats, that could be hilarious - although him having to be untapped would be a fair warning of it, after the first time people see the deck.
